content: काञ्चिः, -ची {%f.%} [काञ्च् बन्धने इनि] .²1 A womanʼs girdle or zone furnished with small tinkling bells or other ornaments; एतावता नन्वनुमेयशोभि काञ्चीगुणस्थानमनिन्दितायाः <ls>Ku. 1. 37</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">3. 55</ls> <ls>Me. 28</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 82</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 43</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of an ancient city in the south of India, regarded as one of the sacred cities of the Hindus; (for the names of seven cities see अवन्ति).
